title: Build and benchmark a temporal-safe FTS5 memory index
description: Build a disposable local SQLite FTS5/BM25 retrieval baseline for MAP durable memory. Separate unique source documents from task/source links, prevent current shared mutable content from being copied into historical task meaning, query weighted task/source/path channels with bounded deterministic decomposition, and fuse ranked lists with reciprocal rank fusion. Score only the known TASK-257 and TASK-258 truth sets as labeled development regressions in this task; freeze the resulting implementation before any later fresh holdout. Measure task/source retrieval, compound coverage, negative handling, build/query latency, database size, path health, and temporal attribution. Do not integrate into startup, routing, Command Center, canonical authority, or external services.
acceptance_criteria: The disposable SQLite schema stores one source document per unique normalized path plus explicit task/source links and temporal-attribution labels; multiply linked mutable current content is not cloned into historical task semantics.

Weighted local FTS5 task/source fields, a path/identifier channel, bounded deterministic subqueries, and reciprocal-rank fusion are implemented without a package, model, network, runtime, router, UI, or canonical-authority dependency.
Focused tests cover deterministic rebuild/query behavior, shared-source temporal handling, RRF, compound retrieval, path health, and abstention signals.

Known TASK-257 and TASK-258 truth sets are labeled development regressions only; the report records task/source metrics, compound and negative behavior, build/query latency, index size, failure analysis, and a frozen-implementation handoff for a later fresh holdout without making an adoption claim.
